subject: general
question: Select the correct option to fill blank 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**at**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**at**" is used when referring to a specific time or place. (पर)
 
• In the context, Jim glanced **at__** his clock to check the time.
 
• The other options: "**in**," "**on**," and "**upon**" do not fit the context of glancing at a clock.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *He groaned and glanced __at__ his clock sleepily.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **In (में)**: is used to indicate the situation of something that is or appears to be enclosed or surrounded by something else.
 
• **On (पर)**: is used to indicate a position above but in contact with something.
 
• **Upon (पर)**: is used more formally to indicate a position on a surface or something that is closely related to something else.
